edits.headline: Drone strike on market in disputed Abyei region kills at least 153
edits.subheadline: A Sudanese military officer said the army had targeted fuel tankers bound for the Rapid Support Forces, the Associated Press reported.
editorialBody: A drone strike on a market in Abyei, a region disputed by Sudan and South Sudan, killed at least 153 people, a local official said, according to the Associated Press. A Sudanese military officer said the army had targeted fuel tankers arriving from South Sudan that he said were bound for the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces, the AP reported.
In Washington, President Donald Trump asked White House correspondent Andrew Feinberg whether he was a sick person during an Oval Office exchange, TheWrap and Newsweek reported.

The Wall Street Journal reported that Elon Musk had ordered a reduction in Starshield satellite services for Ukraine, Asharq Al-Awsat said. Musk suggested the US government was behind any slowdown, the South China Morning Post reported.
